label: Fresh ensemble candidate: direct59; original feature-state objective

layer4ParallelBranches.parameterSharing: each added branch owns independent parameters reused across input and forecast transitions
layer4ParallelBranches.source: current observed W embedding for input transitions and preceding generated NF state for forecast transitions

architecture.numberedLayerSharing: each parenthesized number is one exact shared module reused at every matching block; layers other than 8 remain GNGLUs; layer 8 is one shared causal self-attention module; added layer-4 source branches are independent of one another and reused across transitions
architecture.initialState: branch 1 is the 256-wide P prefix, branch 2 is the 256-wide F feature-distribution state, and three independent W-to-256 GNGLUs form branches 3 through 5; their concatenation is consumed by shared layer 4
architecture.transitionState: on observed-input transitions branches 3 through 5 consume the current W embedding; on forecast transitions they consume the preceding generated NF representation; every layer-4 contraction therefore receives five 256-wide inputs
architecture.outputState: shared layer 7 maps PF to NF; shared layer 8 causally self-attends over the generated NF-state prefix to emit expected W; shared layer 2 decodes W directly to the complete next production59 feature state
architecture.latentSemantics: P, F, the three added source branches, PF, and NF remain unconstrained latent embeddings

loss.description: mean MSE over both future seconds and all 59 directly decoded features after per-feature training-split standardization

sampling.description: the exact original production59 dense chronological nonzero-target population
sampling.comparisonControl: same direct-59 K1/K2 self-attention baseline, sample origins, optimizer, feature objective, training count, batch sizes, and EMA; only P/F widening and three extra layer-4 branches change

evaluation.headline: step-1 next completed 1s signed log return
evaluation.comparableMetrics: step-1 and per-step return metrics remain directly comparable to the direct-59 W256 self-attention control

alignment.input: the same two consecutive production59 timeline rows ending at each control example origin
alignment.target: the same two complete chronological production59 rows at origin+1 and origin+2
alignment.attentionCausality: output step s attends only to generated NF states at output steps less than or equal to s

ensembleRefit.scope: native architecture and loss retained; bounded 64 epoch fresh snapshot; selection by validation feature MSE
